description: This source file defines the functionality to add a follower (follow a user profile) in the Conduit application. It includes a command, validation, and a request handler that interacts with the database context to create a new follow relationship between users.

classes.name: Add
classes.description: Contains the command, validator, and handler classes for the 'add follower' feature.

classes.name: Add.Command
classes.description: Represents the request to add a follower by username.

classes.name: Add.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validates that the username is not null or empty.

classes.name: Add.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the logic for adding a new follower, including database operations and returning the profile envelope.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Processes the 'add follower' command by retrieving user profiles, creating follow relationships if necessary, and returning the profile data.
